name: Simplealphabetshifttwo

description_json.name: SimpleAlphabetShiftTwo
description_json.idea: To ensure perfect implementation correctness and high readability for the model while bypassing simple pattern matchers, we shift all alphabetic characters forward by exactly 2 positions in the alphabet. Non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it forward by 2 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary: encrypt(x) = (x - 'a' + 2) % 26 + 'a'.
2. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it forward by 2 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary: encrypt(x) = (x - 'A' + 2) % 26 + 'A'.
3. If it is any other character (space, digit, punctuation, etc.), leave it completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it backward by 2 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary: decrypt(x) = (x - 'a' - 2) % 26 + 'a'.
2. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it backward by 2 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary: decrypt(x) = (x - 'A' - 2) % 26 + 'A'.
3. If it is any other character (space, digit, punctuation, etc.), leave it completely unchanged.
